trigger: Windows PowerShell 5.1 started with PowerShell 7's PSModulePath: the reset itself called Join-Path (a cmdlet) before taking effect
classification_rationale: the fix depended on module resolution it was fixing
summary: Also cpp-safety, security-guardian, unhappy-path. Worked on the real host, but fixed in 2cb7896e0: $PSHOME+'\Modules;'+machine at all four sites.

trigger: a reader of the changelog/comments: they said the AutoLogger [Run] setup silently skipped under PowerShell 7
summary: Author verified on a real Windows host: Get-AutologgerConfig loads through pwsh -> cmd -> 5.1 with and without the reset; only first-use modules like Microsoft.PowerShell.Security fail. Fixed in 2cb7896e0 (comments and changelog corrected; reset kept on those lines for consistency).

trigger: rc3 installs launched from PowerShell 7: boot process-capture AutoLogger assumed silently skipped
classification_rationale: premise taken from the author's first changelog
summary: Also sre. Refuted by the author's Windows verification above: the AutoLogger cmdlets load without the reset, so rc3 installs were not affected.

trigger: an rc2/rc3 install uninstalled from a PowerShell 7 chain without upgrading: the old recorded removal command runs
classification_rationale: assumed the old removal command fails under pwsh
summary: Refuted by the same verification: the AutoLogger cmdlets work without the reset, so the old removal command succeeds.

trigger: Windows server installed where generate-config.ps1's Set-Acl fails (PowerShell 7 module path, or localized 'BUILTIN\Administrators'): the failure is a warning, exit 0, and yuzu-server.cfg (PBKDF2 hashes) keeps ProgramData's inherited Users:Read
summary: Also cross-platform and security-guardian. This diff removes the PowerShell 7 trigger. The changelog tells affected servers to restrict the file and change passwords. trigger: server installer's generate-config call loads profiles before the reset
summary: Fixed in 2cb7896e0.

adjudicated_by: enterprise-architect (Claude Fable 5.1), independent of author and reporter
adjudication_rationale: Independent adjudication (enterprise-architect; not the author, not the reporter). The fail-open is pre-existing: introduced with the server installer in eac788cd6 (2026-04-08) and shipped since v0.13.0 (`git show v0.13.0:deploy/packaging/windows/generate-config.ps1:79-82`). #5200 neither introduces nor widens it and narrows one of its two triggers by resetting PSModulePath. The server installer is shipped (`release.yml` builds YuzuServerSetup), so this is not waived as unsupported. The accepted scope (#5176, the PowerShell 7 abort) is satisfied without this fix (Gate 7 Test 2), and the Gate 8 round on 27a549797 established that closing it requires a directory-level ownership/ACL lifecycle with upgrade semantics (Test 1: new ownership lifecycle), an independently reviewable surface; a per-file fix labelled `fixed` would be I6 false assurance. Band stays BLOCKING/I1; deferred to #5196 (P1, milestone 0.14.0, must land before final). Exposure is disclosed with an interim workaround in the changelog fragment.
